environment.description: Same application deployed behind AWS CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge viewer-request function that enforces Content-Security-Policy with require-sri-for directive and validates all POST request bodies against a JSON Schema that restricts 'query' field values to string-keyed objects where all values must be primitive types (string, number, boolean) — effectively disallowing MongoDB operator keys starting with '$'. The Lambda@Edge function (Node.js 18.x) uses ajv with 'patternProperties' schema validation where property names matching '^\$' are set to false (additionalProperties pattern). Additionally, the MongoDB connection uses a custom PyMongo command monitoring listener that rejects any find command containing $where, $expr, or nested $gt/$ne operators on non-numeric fields, implemented as a CommandStartedEvent handler that raises OperationFailure before the command reaches the server.

config.mongodb_monitor: CommandStartedEvent listener rejecting operator injection patterns in find commands
config.sri_enforcement: All script tags require valid integrity attribute matching sha384 hash
